description: Plum Blossom (梅花易数) divination for one question, from the moment or from two numbers: original / mutual / changed hexagrams, body and use. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the user's language without changing the judgement. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.05 per cast.

options.description: School / rule options as { group: id }; defaults match mingge.org. See list_options for groups and ids.

topic.description: What the question is about: wealth_seek money, career_promo promotion, job_seek job hunt, love_can will this romance work, marriage, partnership business partner, waiting_news news, waiting_person someone's arrival, travel, lost_item, lawsuit, illness, other.

tz.description: Asker's IANA time zone; alone = cast for this moment

variant.description: Sub-case for some topics (same values as cast_liuyao: lost_item, love, illness…)

way.description: now (default): from the moment; number: from two numbers the asker thought of
